title: Self-service supplier return journeys
story: As a procurement operations coordinator, I want to manage supplier return requests from submission through authorization, pickup, and credit confirmation so that I can close returns without chasing email and spreadsheets.
why_now: The item is too large to sequence safely and is currently estimated at 35 points.
product_outcome: Reduce coordinator handling time while giving requesters visible progress.

invest_context.independent: No blocking backlog dependency; the current email process remains available.
invest_context.negotiable: The brief fixes user outcomes and policy, not implementation architecture.
invest_context.valuable: Coordinators and requesters can complete and track a return journey.
invest_context.estimable: The team can estimate the capability slices in story points.
invest_context.testable: Policy and workflow outcomes are specified in the bundled rules.
invest_context.small: Fails: 35 points exceeds the team ceiling.

scope.name: Basic end-to-end return
scope.description: Single-item standard domestic request via a basic form, automatic authorization when eligible, manually arranged pickup, credit-memo confirmation, and visible status through closure.

scope.name: High-value approval
scope.description: Route high-value standard returns to a procurement manager before pickup.

scope.name: Regulated-item route
scope.description: Compliance approval and specialist carrier handling for regulated goods.

scope.name: International route
scope.description: Collect and validate customs declarations before an international pickup.

scope.name: Bulk CSV entry
scope.description: Upload many return lines with row-level validation and partial acceptance.

scope.name: Attachment convenience
scope.description: Drag-and-drop multiple attachments with previews instead of the basic single-file control.

scope.name: Automatic carrier booking
scope.description: Book eligible pickups through the validated carrier adapter instead of operations arranging them manually.

scope.name: Stage SLA dashboard
scope.description: Show operations which returns are approaching or breaching stage-level service targets.

scope.name: Peak-load performance
scope.description: Meet the peak response objective for basic submission and status checks.
